column1: # The eval task table. Tab-separated; `#` starts a comment; adding a task is one line.
# id              short, stable, quoted in ablation results
# reference       the commit that fixes the task AND adds the test that catches it
# test_path       the full Rust path of that test, as `cargo test -- --exact` wants it
# test_file       the file the test lives in, relative to the repo root, in the reference
# The reference commit is the only place the test is ever read from. A candidate tree's
# own copy of it -- however it got there -- is deleted before the reference version is
# grafted in, so an agent cannot score by writing a test that passes.
